backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing product management with category filtering, user authentication with session tokens, role-based access control, and Amazon product metadata extraction via HTML parsing with priority-based field extraction and validation.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the requirement to change font color of all primary action buttons in admin components (AdminLogin, AdminPanel, ProductManagement) to blue with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including routing, product management, authentication, admin panels with blue button text, and performance optimizations with detailed logging and session token tracking.
frontend/CLOUDFLARE_CDN_SETUP.md: Step-by-step guide for configuring Cloudflare CDN optimizations including auto-minify, Brotli compression, Rocket Loader, caching rules, image optimization, HTTP/3, and mobile-specific settings with verification and troubleshooting instructions.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Deployment troubleshooting guide documenting production failure due to missing favicon reference, resolution steps, and comprehensive go-live checklist covering static assets, build verification, service worker registration, and common deployment issues.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with comprehensive SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter cards, structured data for Kolkata-based fashion affiliate site, and preloaded critical assets (hero banner, logo).
frontend/PERFORMANCE_ACTION_PLAN.md: Performance optimization action plan targeting Lighthouse scores of 90+ mobile and 95+ desktop through phased implementation of Cloudflare optimizations, JavaScript bundle reduction, image optimization, and resource hints.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZATION.md: Detailed documentation of implemented performance optimizations including critical CSS inlining, responsive image srcset with AVIF/WebP, React.lazy code splitting, service worker caching strategies, Core Web Vitals tracking, and CSS animation optimization.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt file allowing all crawlers and pointing to sitemap.xml.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap with single homepage entry, daily change frequency, and priority 1.0.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first for static assets, network-first for HTML/API, with versioned cache management and exclusion of robots.txt/sitemap.xml from caching.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component with lazy-loaded routes (home, products, admin, sitemap), authentication handling, and route-based rendering logic with 404 fallback.
frontend/src/components/admin/BlogManage: Placeholder component displaying a message that blog management functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/admin/Newsletter: Placeholder component displaying a message that newsletter management functionality has been removed.

frontend/src/components/admin/SitePagesM: Placeholder component displaying a message that site pages management functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin authentication modal supporting custom username/password registration/login and Internet Identity, with password strength validation and error handling.
frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard with tabbed interface for managing products, blog, newsletter, and site pages, plus logout functionality for both custom auth and Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/AmazonBanner.tsx: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Dialog modal displaying a message that blog functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/BlogTeaser.tsx: Memoized component that returns null, effectively hiding the blog teaser section since blog functionality was removed.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with newsletter signup form (disabled), quick links, Kolkata location info, trust badges, social media links, and Amazon Associates disclaimer.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header component with logo, navigation links (Home, Products, Admin), and client-side routing using pushState and popstate events.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero banner section with gradient background, call-to-action buttons for shopping, and trust badges; includes smooth scroll to products section.
frontend/src/components/OptimizedImage.t: Image component with lazy loading via IntersectionObserver, WebP format support with PNG fallback, responsive srcset, and error handling.
frontend/src/components/PageModal.tsx: Modal component displaying static content for privacy policy, terms of service, and contact pages with close functionality.
frontend/src/components/PasswordStrength: Password strength indicator showing visual bar and feedback messages based on weak/medium/strong validation levels.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Product listing grid with filtering by category and price range, sorting options, and memoized product cards displaying images, prices, and Amazon affiliate links.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/RobotsTxt.tsx: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/Sitemap.tsx: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/SocialProof.tsx: Social proof section displaying customer testimonials with star ratings and a rotating carousel of recent purchase notifications.
frontend/src/components/Spinner.tsx: A reusable SVG-based loading spinner component with animation and accessibility attributes.
frontend/src/components/TrustBadges.tsx: Displays trust badges (Kolkata-based, Amazon Associates, secure checkout, money-back guarantee, SSL) with configurable horizontal or vertical layout and bilingual alt text.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Zustand store with persistence for managing authentication state including session tokens, username, and 24-hour session expiration with automatic cleanup.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAuth.ts: React Query mutations for user registration, authentication, and logout operations with the backend actor, including error handling and toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Provides two hooks: useDebounce for debouncing values and useDebouncedCallback for debouncing callback functions with configurable delay (default 300ms).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating data from the backend actor, including admin checks, product queries (all, by category, fashion), filtering, and mutations for adding/updating/deleting products with optimistic updates and toast notifications.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space, featuring a gold and navy color scheme with WCAG AA+ compliance and custom utilities for card hover effects and price range sliders.
frontend/src/lib/web-vitals.d.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the web-vitals library, declaring metric types and report handler functions for Core Web Vitals (CLS, FID, FCP, LCP, TTFB).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin page component that handles authentication state (custom auth or Internet Identity), verifies admin privileges, and conditionally renders AdminLogin or AdminPanel with loading and access denied states.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Memoized products page component that displays a header section with gradient background and renders the ProductGrid component to show all products.
frontend/src/pages/SitemapPage.tsx: Generates and renders a basic XML sitemap on page load with URLs for the home page and products page, using the backend canister ID to construct the base URL.
frontend/src/utils/delayedScripts.ts: Utility for delaying third-party script injection until 3 seconds after page load to improve initial render performance and Core Web Vitals scores.
frontend/src/utils/passwordValidation.ts: Password validation utilities that check strength (weak/medium/strong) based on length, character types, and special characters, with functions for matching confirmation passwords and listing requirements.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter utilities for extracting values from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and functions to clear sensitive parameters from the URL after extraction.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file that defines custom color schemes using OKLCH color space (including gold, navy, sidebar, and semantic colors), container settings, border radius variables, and integrates typography, container queries, and animation plugins.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite build configuration that sets up React, path aliases, environment variables for DFX network and canister IDs, API proxy for local/production ICP backends, and optimized production builds with code splitting for React, UI libraries, and ICP dependencies.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting a feature request to change Admin Panel button font colors to blue and a known authorization issue with adding products; includes one completed feature and two pending action requests.
